sources.title: CraftJarvis/JarvisVLA-Qwen2-VL-7B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Introduction JarvisVLA-Qwen2-VL-7B is a Visual-Language-Action (VLA) model specifically tailored for the open-world game Minecraft. Based on human language instructions, JarvisVLA-Qwen2-VL-7B masters thousands of in-game skills, empowering endless creativity and interaction in Minecraft's expansive universe!

sources.title: JARVIS-VLA: Post-Training Large-Scale Vision Language Models to Play ...
sources.snippet: In our experiments, we employ Llava-Next [27] and Qwen2-VL [43] as base vision language models, as both models provide robust support for multi-image reasoning, enabling enhanced perception and contextual understanding. Another key distinguishing feature of JARVIS-VLA compared to prior VLA models is the integration of an action decoder.
